overview: This House resolution assigns four House members to standing committees, the permanent panels that write and review legislation. It places Ms. Ansari on the Education and Workforce Committee, Mr. Green of Texas on the Homeland Security Committee, Ms. Lee of Nevada on the Natural Resources Committee, and Mr. Foster on the Science, Space, and Technology Committee. The House adopted it on May 20, 2025.
for: Supporters say it is a routine step that fills committee seats so members can take part in drafting and reviewing legislation.
against: Critics say it is a routine internal matter that does not change any law or policy.
